'''MandalTech''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] company located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. A sister company to [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]], MandalTech specialized in the development of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and weapons.<ref name="TCSWE" /> Along with MandalMotors and [[Mandal Hypernautics Corporation|Mandal Hypernautics]],<ref name="RECG">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> MandalTech was a producer of the [[Canderous-class assault tank|''Canderous''-class assault tank]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> Many of MandalTech's designs that were not intentionally created for warfare were found to be easily adapted to [[Army/Legends|military]] use, all the same.<ref name="TBHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
MandalTech was first introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] via a brief mention in [[2008]] in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', and under the entry for the ''Canderous''-class assault tank. The company was later mentioned again in the reference book ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'', a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] guide [[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Daniel Wallace]], [[Jason Fry]], and [[Ryder Windham]].
